en.headline: Observatory forecasts cooler weather from Monday as cold front and northeast monsoon…
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a cold front will cross the South China coast early Monday, followed by an intense northeast monsoon that will bring appreciably lower temperatures, with urban minima around 18 degrees…
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a strong northeast monsoon is affecting the coast of Guangdong. A cold front is expected to move across the South China coast early on Monday, after which an intense northeast monsoon will strengthen northerly winds and cause temperatures to fall appreciably.

The Observatory forecast that Monday morning will be cooler with strong northerly winds, becoming fine and dry during the day before temperatures fall further at night. On Tuesday and Wednesday, mornings are expected to be generally cool, with minimum temperatures of around 18 degrees or below in urban areas and lower in parts of the New Territories.

The Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force for easterly winds, with mean speeds expected to exceed 40 kilometres per hour and occasional gale-force gusts. The Observatory advised people in exposed areas to secure loose objects and cautioned those planning sea activities about rough conditions offshore.

Looking further ahead, the Observatory said the middle of next week is expected to be mainly fine and dry across Guangdong, with larger day-night temperature differences inland, while upper-air disturbances may bring showers later in the week.

zh.headline: 天文台料下周一冷鋒及強烈東北季候風抵港 氣溫顯著下降
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，一道冷鋒將於下周一初時橫過華南沿岸，隨後強烈東北季候風令氣溫明顯下降，下周二市區最低氣溫約18度。
body: 香港天文台指，一股達強風程度的東北季候風正影響廣東沿岸。預料一道冷鋒將於下周一初時橫過華南沿岸，其後的強烈東北季候風會令北風增強，氣溫顯著下降。
天文台預測，下周一早上天氣較涼並轉吹偏北強風，日間漸轉天晴乾燥，晚上氣溫進一步下降。下周二及下周三早上普遍清涼，市區最低氣溫約18度或以下，新界部分地區會更低。
強烈季候風信號仍然生效，預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速超過每小時40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。天文台提醒身處當風地方的人士採取預防措施，並呼籲計劃水上活動的人士注意離岸海域風浪較大。
展望下周中期，廣東地區普遍晴朗及乾燥，內陸日夜溫差較大，高空擾動或於下周後期帶來驟雨。
